text_block_list.text:
During summer training camp, a 
recreational tournament was held, and 
Eishin Flash participated in it as well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm entered, I'm aiming for 
victory. Even if the competition is fierce 
this time—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—I will see this through to the end. 
Defeat has no place in my plans.
choice_data_list: I'm rooting for you! Do your best!

text_block_list.text:
After saying that to Eishin Flash, I head 
back to the stands—and with that, the 
competition kicked off!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The first event is Free-Form Orienteering! 
Freely visit any 5 checkpoints on the map, 
and the first one back wins!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...The next closest checkpoint is past 
the cliff. There is no choice; we must 
detour around—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? A dead end? Then, I'll just use 
this—
(BOOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what... She moved a fallen tree to make 
a bridge...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: H, He, Li, Be... Got it! Right here!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"So fast! Gold Ship has clocked in with 
the provisional 1st place time in Speed 
Watermelon Splitting!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, did ya see that?! That's the 
power of science! At least remember sine, 
cosine, and tangent before ya head home, 
dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't understand... It makes no sense 
at all. Why the watermelon's position... 
The logic falls apart!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
O-Orfe-san... What an incredible aura...! 
What do I do? Even aiming my water gun at 
her feels impossible...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hoh. Naturally, you are prepared for what 
that entails?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Naturally—there is no way I could possibly 
back down!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Hah! Hmph!
(WHOOOOSH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“The winner is Orfevre~~!! The wind has 
cut through Eishin Flash's water! Does 
this king make even nature itself kneel 
before her!?”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: toi,toi,toi……。

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Phew...— Stay calm. I have no time to lose 
my composure...
choice_data_list: I need to think during this interval...
I need to think during this interval...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I thought I understood, of course, 
but... my assumptions were naive. They 
were off the charts.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I will identify the discrepancies and 
revise the plan. In these 5 minutes and 13 
seconds, I will make it even more 
flawless—!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The next kick-up contest is bound to take 
an unpredictable turn as well, no doubt.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So, I changed into a swimsuit to ensure 
mobility. Collected anything that could be 
used as a ball. And just in case, weapons 
too—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Course correction completed. From here on 
out, I shall catch up.
choice_data_list: Let's exhaust every single option we have!

...Let's all just take a deep breath for a 
second!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's a plan I've thought through 
carefully—I'm sure it will live up to your 
expectations, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hup, hup, fuu, hah— Alright, I'm getting 
the hang of it!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "...Ho-ho-ho. Splendidly done."

And so, Eishin Flash dove enthusiastically 
into the competition—and ended up 
achieving a magnificent result!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hoo, fuu, fuu—yeah. I'm putting up a real 
fight...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Hah, matching pace with the great 
Golshi-chan?! You must've already lost 
your baby teeth, huh!

And so, Eishin Flash dove enthusiastically 
into the competition—and ended up putting 
on a performance every bit as impressive 
as her formidable rivals!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Dull. Step aside.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Kh... Even after all this, you still 
won't...!

And so, Eishin Flash dove enthusiastically 
into the competition—only to end up with 
rather underwhelming results...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Ahem, my apologies. It seems I was 
lacking in composure.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
3 minutes and 23 seconds remain until the 
start of the next event. I shall use this 
time to reconsider the plan.
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can do to help?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for your concern. If that's 
the case, please watch me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure. I will formulate a 
completely airtight plan.

Using the limited time to re-strategize, 
Eishin Flash— as a result, managed to 
achieve an impressive performance.
